title: Ukrainian-Style Pilaf with Nutty Flavor
description: A hearty and flavorful pilaf dish with a nutty taste, made with ukrainian pilaf and pilowy texture. A great vegetarian option for any meal.
instructions: Heat the butter in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the pilaf and cook, stirring constantly, for 2-3 minutes.
Add the chopped nutty and stir to combine.
Add the water and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
